answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in marble, expire in kernel, and willow lists each expiry. Someone running 186 aliases as a result needs 93 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3738 identities would post 4413 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
